scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@jigbench/core && npm run build --workspace=@jigbench/server && npm run build --workspace=@jigbench/cli --workspace=@jigbench/adapter-angular --workspace=@jigbench/adapter-dotnet && npm run build --workspace=@jigbench/bench
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@jigbench/core && npm run build --workspace=@jigbench/server && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,bench "npm run dev --workspace=@jigbench/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@jigbench/bench"
